profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Generalist who enjoys both solving open-ended problems and contributing where it's most needed. 

For the past several years, I've worked closely with my team to advance and maintain a large distributed system. In that space, I've coded mostly in Java and Python, glued things together with bash and SQL, and deployed to AWS infrastructure on a daily basis. I've been responsible for everything from coding, testing, deployment, debugging, analysis, and monitoring, to mentoring junior engineers and promoting best practices within the team. I enjoy designing and building tools to constantly improve and tune the system to keep it operating at full capacity. My goal is to automate my job away as much as possible.

projects.title: Crusoe
projects.description: Crusoe is a messaging app that allows users to share messages that are associated with a physical place for others to discover. When a message is submitted, it begins to drift away from its original location and when it enters another user's proximity, they can unlock its contents.

projects.title: NomNow 2.0
projects.description: Crowdsourced wait times for restaurants - built in MySQL, Express, Angular, and Node.
